name: produce an installed filesystem with intact core os files and an account
definition: Ensure the system contains core os binaries whose content hashes are recognized and that the required user account was created.
failure_mode: an incomplete or corrupt install lowers the verified file rate

name: replace secrets with consistent placeholder markers
definition: Substitute each found secret with a fixed, per-type placeholder literally preserves these placeholders and ensure all occurrences map to the same token type across the whole tree.
